title: Vision oversized, corrupt, and spoofed-image behavior
goal: Verify deterministic image boundary failures occur before provider dispatch and extension spoofing uses magic bytes.
prompt: Analyze each fixture with vision.analyze and report the structured result.
prerequisites: Provider calls are optional for this task because corrupt and oversized inputs must fail before dispatch.
steps: Analyze the oversized fixture and record the structured error.
Analyze the corrupt fixture and record the structured error.
Analyze the extension-spoof fixture only after explicitly enabling any required live provider call.
assertions: Input above the configured 32 MiB source-read ceiling returns source-too-large without provider dispatch or cost.
Corrupt input returns source-corrupt without provider dispatch or cost.
The .jpg spoof is detected and normalized as PNG from magic bytes.
notes: The deterministic eval fixture also covers these boundaries without network access.
Accuracy percent is the percentage of the three expected boundary outcomes.
